```{r}
cat("  Formula:", deparse(formula_model4), "\n")
cat("  N predictors:", length(vars_model4), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# D. Fit models using mice
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART D: Fitting logistic regression models\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

cat("Fitting models across", mids_data$m, "imputed datasets...\n")
cat("Note: Ordinal variables will produce one coefficient each (not polynomial contrasts)\n\n")

# Function to fit models on each imputed dataset
fit_model_on_imputations <- function(mids_obj, formula_obj, model_name) {
  cat("Fitting", model_name, "...\n")
  
  # Create empty list to store model fits
  fit_list <- vector("list", mids_obj$m)
  
  # Fit model on each imputed dataset
  for(i in 1:mids_obj$m) {
    data_complete <- complete(mids_obj, i)
    fit_list[[i]] <- glm(formula_obj, data = data_complete, family = binomial)
  }
  
  # Convert to mira object for pooling
  fit_mira <- as.mira(fit_list)
  
  cat("✓", model_name, "complete\n\n")
  return(fit_mira)
}

# Model 1: Demographics
fit_model1 <- fit_model_on_imputations(mids_data, formula_model1, "Model 1 (Demographics)")
pooled_model1 <- pool(fit_model1)

# Model 2: Demographics + Personality
fit_model2 <- fit_model_on_imputations(mids_data, formula_model2, "Model 2 (Demographics + Personality)")
pooled_model2 <- pool(fit_model2)

# Model 3: Demographics + Clinical
fit_model3 <- fit_model_on_imputations(mids_data, formula_model3, "Model 3 (Demographics + Clinical)")
pooled_model3 <- pool(fit_model3)

# Model 4: Full model
fit_model4 <- fit_model_on_imputations(mids_data, formula_model4, "Model 4 (Full Model)")
pooled_model4 <- pool(fit_model4)

# ==============================================================================
# E. Extract and summarize results
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART E: Extracting model summaries\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Function to get tidy summary with OR and CI
get_model_summary <- function(pooled_model, model_name) {
  summary_df <- summary(pooled_model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      OR = exp(estimate),
      OR_lower = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
      OR_upper = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
      sig = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
        p.value < 0.10 ~ ".",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      model = model_name
    ) %>%
    select(model, term, estimate, std.error, OR, OR_lower, OR_upper, 
           statistic, p.value, sig)
  
  return(summary_df)
}

summary_model1 <- get_model_summary(pooled_model1, "Model 1: Demographics")
summary_model2 <- get_model_summary(pooled_model2, "Model 2: Demo + Personality")
summary_model3 <- get_model_summary(pooled_model3, "Model 3: Demo + Clinical")
summary_model4 <- get_model_summary(pooled_model4, "Model 4: Full")

# Combine all summaries
all_summaries <- bind_rows(summary_model1, summary_model2, summary_model3, summary_model4)

cat("✓ Model summaries extracted\n")
cat("  Each ordinal variable now has ONE coefficient (not .L, .Q, .C, etc.)\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# F. Calculate model performance metrics
# ==============================================================================

cat("PART F: Calculating model performance metrics\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Function to calculate AUC for each imputed dataset and pool
calculate_pooled_auc <- function(fit_object, mids_data, formula_obj) {
  aucs <- numeric(mids_data$m)
  
  for(i in 1:mids_data$m) {
    # Get complete data for this imputation
    data_complete <- complete(mids_data, i)
    
    # Fit model on this imputation
    model_i <- glm(formula_obj, data = data_complete, family = binomial)
    
    # Get predictions
    pred_i <- predict(model_i, type = "response")
    
    # Calculate AUC
    roc_i <- roc(data_complete[[outcome_var]], pred_i, quiet = TRUE)
    aucs[i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_i))
  }
  
  # Return mean and SD
  return(data.frame(
    AUC_mean = mean(aucs),
    AUC_sd = sd(aucs),
    AUC_lower = mean(aucs) - 1.96 * sd(aucs),
    AUC_upper = mean(aucs) + 1.96 * sd(aucs)
  ))
}

cat("Calculating AUC for Model 1...\n")
auc_model1 <- calculate_pooled_auc(fit_model1, mids_data, formula_model1)

cat("Calculating AUC for Model 2...\n")
auc_model2 <- calculate_pooled_auc(fit_model2, mids_data, formula_model2)

cat("Calculating AUC for Model 3...\n")
auc_model3 <- calculate_pooled_auc(fit_model3, mids_data, formula_model3)

cat("Calculating AUC for Model 4...\n")
auc_model4 <- calculate_pooled_auc(fit_model4, mids_data, formula_model4)

cat("✓ AUC calculations complete\n\n")

# Create performance comparison table
performance_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Model 1: Demographics",
            "Model 2: Demo + Personality",
            "Model 3: Demo + Clinical",
            "Model 4: Full"),
  N_Predictors = c(length(vars_model1), length(vars_model2), 
                   length(vars_model3), length(vars_model4)),
  AUC = c(auc_model1$AUC_mean, auc_model2$AUC_mean, 
          auc_model3$AUC_mean, auc_model4$AUC_mean),
  AUC_Lower = c(auc_model1$AUC_lower, auc_model2$AUC_lower,
                auc_model3$AUC_lower, auc_model4$AUC_lower),
  AUC_Upper = c(auc_model1$AUC_upper, auc_model2$AUC_upper,
                auc_model3$AUC_upper, auc_model4$AUC_upper)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_AUC = AUC - lag(AUC, default = 0),

# Function to print model results nicely
print_model_results <- function(summary_df, model_name, auc_stats) {
  cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat(model_name, "\n")
  cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")
  
  cat("Performance:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  AUC: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]\n\n", 
              auc_stats$AUC_mean, auc_stats$AUC_lower, auc_stats$AUC_upper))
  
  cat("Coefficients:\n")
  results_display <- summary_df %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    select(term, OR, OR_lower, OR_upper, p.value, sig) %>%
    mutate(
      OR_CI = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
      p_formatted = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
    ) %>%
    select(term, OR_CI, p_formatted, sig)
  
  print(results_display, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r}
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 3: UNIVARIATE LOGISTIC REGRESSIONS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Function to manually pool logistic regression results using Rubin's rules
pool_manual <- function(coef_list, se_list) {
  m <- length(coef_list)
  
  # Average coefficient
  coef_pooled <- mean(coef_list)
  
  # Within-imputation variance
  W <- mean(se_list^2)
  
  # Between-imputation variance
  B <- var(coef_list)
  
  # Total variance
  T <- W + (1 + 1/m) * B
  se_pooled <- sqrt(T)
  
  # Test statistic
  t_stat <- coef_pooled / se_pooled
  
  # Degrees of freedom
  lambda <- ((1 + 1/m) * B) / T
  df <- (m - 1) / lambda^2
  
  # p-value
  p_value <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = df)
  
  return(list(
    estimate = coef_pooled,
    se = se_pooled,
    p_value = p_value
  ))
}

univariate_results <- list()

for(var in all_predictors) {
  cat("Analyzing:", var, "...\n")
  
  # Run model on each imputation
  coef_list <- c()
  se_list <- c()
  
  for(i in 1:mids_data$m) {
    data_imp <- complete(mids_data, i)
    
    # Fit model
    formula_uni <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", var))
    fit <- glm(formula_uni, data = data_imp, family = binomial)
    
    # Extract coefficient and SE
    coef_list[i] <- coef(fit)[2]
    se_list[i] <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 2]
  }
  
  # Pool results
  pooled <- pool_manual(coef_list, se_list)
  
  # Calculate OR and CI
  or <- exp(pooled$estimate)
  or_lower <- exp(pooled$estimate - 1.96 * pooled$se)
  or_upper <- exp(pooled$estimate + 1.96 * pooled$se)
  
  univariate_results[[var]] <- data.frame(
    Variable = var,
    OR = or,
    OR_95CI = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", or_lower, or_upper),
    p_value = pooled$p_value,
    Significant = ifelse(pooled$p_value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  cat(sprintf("  %-25s OR = %.2f [%.2f, %.2f], p = %s %s\n", 
              var, or, or_lower, or_upper,
              format.pval(pooled$p_value, digits = 3),
              ifelse(pooled$p_value < 0.05, "***", "")))
}

cat("\n")
univariate_table <- bind_rows(univariate_results)
write.csv(univariate_table, "univariate_logistic_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: univariate_logistic_results.csv\n\n")

# STEP 4: MULTIVARIABLE MODEL (MANUAL POOLING)
#==============================================================================

# Run full model on each imputation
coef_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = mids_data$m, ncol = length(all_predictors))
se_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = mids_data$m, ncol = length(all_predictors))
colnames(coef_matrix) <- all_predictors
colnames(se_matrix) <- all_predictors

for(i in 1:mids_data$m) {
  data_imp <- complete(mids_data, i)
  
  # Fit full model
  formula_full <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(all_predictors, collapse = " + ")))
  fit <- glm(formula_full, data = data_imp, family = binomial)
  
  # Extract coefficients and SEs
  coef_matrix[i, ] <- coef(fit)[2:(length(all_predictors) + 1)]
  se_matrix[i, ] <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2:(length(all_predictors) + 1), 2]
}

# Pool results for each variable
cat("MULTIVARIABLE MODEL RESULTS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

multivariable_results <- list()

for(j in 1:length(all_predictors)) {
  var <- all_predictors[j]
  
  pooled <- pool_manual(coef_matrix[, j], se_matrix[, j])
  
  or <- exp(pooled$estimate)
  or_lower <- exp(pooled$estimate - 1.96 * pooled$se)
  or_upper <- exp(pooled$estimate + 1.96 * pooled$se)
  
  multivariable_results[[var]] <- list(
    estimate = pooled$estimate,
    se = pooled$se,
    p_value = pooled$p_value,
    or = or,
    or_lower = or_lower,
    or_upper = or_upper
  )
  
  cat(sprintf("%-25s OR = %.2f [%.2f, %.2f], p = %s %s\n", 
              var, or, or_lower, or_upper,
              format.pval(pooled$p_value, digits = 3),
              ifelse(pooled$p_value < 0.05, "***", "")))
}

# Calculate VIF on first imputation (representative)
data1 <- complete(mids_data, 1)
formula_full <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(all_predictors, collapse = " + ")))
fit_vif <- glm(formula_full, data = data1, family = binomial)
vif_values <- vif(fit_vif)

# Handle case where vif() returns a matrix (for categorical variables) or vector
if(is.matrix(vif_values)) {
  # For categorical variables, vif() returns a matrix with GVIF column
  vif_clean <- vif_values[, "GVIF"]
  var_names <- rownames(vif_values)
} else {
  # For continuous variables, vif() returns a named vector
  vif_clean <- vif_values
  var_names <- names(vif_values)
}

vif_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = var_names,
  VIF = as.numeric(vif_clean),
  Interpretation = sapply(vif_clean, function(v) {
    if(v > 10) "SEVERE" else if(v > 5) "MODERATE" else if(v > 2.5) "MILD" else "None"
  })
)

for(i in 1:nrow(vif_table)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-25s VIF = %.2f (%s)\n", 
              vif_table$Variable[i], vif_table$VIF[i], vif_table$Interpretation[i]))
}

  Multivariable_OR = sapply(all_predictors, function(v) multivariable_results[[v]]$or),
  Multivariable_lower = sapply(all_predictors, function(v) multivariable_results[[v]]$or_lower),
  Multivariable_upper = sapply(all_predictors, function(v) multivariable_results[[v]]$or_upper)
)

plot(1, type = "n", xlim = c(0, max(comparison_data$Univariate_upper) + 0.5),
     ylim = c(0.5, nrow(comparison_data) * 2 + 0.5),
     xlab = "Odds Ratio", ylab = "", yaxt = "n",
     main = "Univariate vs Multivariable Odds Ratios")

for(i in 1:nrow(comparison_data)) {

  segments(comparison_data$Univariate_lower[i], y_pos,

The answer is clear from your results:

DBAS_Medications is the only truly significant predictor - it's significant in both univariate AND multivariable models
The other VSURF-selected variables (SURPS_Hopelessness, Neuroticism, dependence_2, side_effects_1, n_sleep_conditions) are NOT significant even in univariate models
This is NOT a multicollinearity issue - VIF values are all excellent (< 1.25)

What this means:

VSURF likely identified these variables because they contribute to overall prediction accuracy in the random forest model, even if their individual effects aren't statistically significant
Random forests can detect weak patterns, non-linear effects, or interactions that don't show up as significant main effects in logistic regression
The non-significant variables may help with prediction in specific subgroups or through interactions

For your manuscript:
Report that DBAS_Medications is the robust, significant predictor that emerged from both variable selection and significance testing. The other variables may have predictive value in the random forest context but don't have independent significant effects in traditional regression.\n\n")
```

```{r}
get_enhanced_continuous_desc <- function(var, mids_obj, group_var = "scrn_stopped_bzra") {
  
  desc_list <- lapply(1:mids_obj$m, function(i) {
    data <- complete(mids_obj, i) %>%
      mutate(group = factor(!!sym(group_var),
                           levels = c(0, 1),
                           labels = c("Continuer", "Discontinuer")))
    
    data %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(var))) %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean = mean(!!sym(var), na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(!!sym(var), na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(!!sym(var), na.rm = TRUE),
        q25 = quantile(!!sym(var), 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75 = quantile(!!sym(var), 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })
  
  # Pool across imputations
  pooled <- bind_rows(desc_list) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      n = round(mean(n)),
      mean = mean(mean),
      sd = mean(sd),
      median = mean(median),
      q25 = mean(q25),
      q75 = mean(q75),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  return(pooled)
}

# FIXED: Categorical description function
get_enhanced_categorical_desc <- function(var, mids_obj, group_var = "scrn_stopped_bzra") {
  
  desc_list <- lapply(1:mids_obj$m, function(i) {
    data <- complete(mids_obj, i) %>%
      mutate(group = factor(!!sym(group_var),
                           levels = c(0, 1),
                           labels = c("Continuer", "Discontinuer")))
    
    # Convert to factor if needed, but preserve all levels
    if(!is.factor(data[[var]])) {
      data[[var]] <- factor(data[[var]])
    }
    
    # Calculate frequencies for each group
    result <- data %>%
      filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      mutate(group_total = n()) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(group, !!sym(var), .drop = FALSE) %>%  # .drop = FALSE keeps all factor levels
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        group_total = first(group_total),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(var))) %>%  # Remove NA category for cleaner output
      mutate(pct = 100 * n / group_total)
    
    return(result)
  })
  
  # Pool across imputations
  pooled <- bind_rows(desc_list) %>%
    group_by(group, !!sym(var)) %>%
    summarise(
      n = mean(n),
      pct = mean(pct),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  return(pooled)
}

calculate_enhanced_effect_sizes <- function(var, mids_obj, group_var = "scrn_stopped_bzra",
                                           is_categorical = FALSE) {
  
  effect_list <- lapply(1:mids_obj$m, function(i) {
    data <- complete(mids_obj, i) %>%
      mutate(group = factor(!!sym(group_var),
                           levels = c(0, 1),
                           labels = c("Continuer", "Discontinuer")))
    
    data_clean <- data %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(var)), !is.na(group))
    
    if(nrow(data_clean) < 10) return(NULL)
    
    if(!is_categorical && is.numeric(data_clean[[var]])) {
      # CONTINUOUS VARIABLE EFFECT SIZES
      
      # Cohen's d
      cohens_d <- tryCatch({
        effectsize::cohens_d(as.formula(paste(var, "~", "group")),
                            data = data_clean,
                            pooled_sd = TRUE,
                            ci = 0.95)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      # Rank-biserial correlation (for Mann-Whitney)
      rank_bis <- tryCatch({
        effectsize::rank_biserial(as.formula(paste(var, "~", "group")),
                                 data = data_clean,
                                 ci = 0.95)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      list(
        cohens_d = if(!is.null(cohens_d)) cohens_d$Cohens_d else NA,
        cohens_d_ci_low = if(!is.null(cohens_d)) cohens_d$CI_low else NA,
        cohens_d_ci_high = if(!is.null(cohens_d)) cohens_d$CI_high else NA,
        rank_biserial = if(!is.null(rank_bis)) rank_bis$r_rank_biserial else NA,
        rank_bis_ci_low = if(!is.null(rank_bis)) rank_bis$CI_low else NA,
        rank_bis_ci_high = if(!is.null(rank_bis)) rank_bis$CI_high else NA
      )
      
    } else {
      # CATEGORICAL VARIABLE EFFECT SIZES
      
      if(!is.factor(data_clean[[var]])) {
        data_clean[[var]] <- factor(data_clean[[var]])
      }
      
      tab <- table(data_clean$group, data_clean[[var]])
      
      cramers <- tryCatch({
        effectsize::cramers_v(tab, ci = 0.95)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      list(
        cramers_v = if(!is.null(cramers)) cramers$Cramers_v else NA,
        cramers_ci_low = if(!is.null(cramers)) cramers$CI_low else NA,
        cramers_ci_high = if(!is.null(cramers)) cramers$CI_high else NA
      )
    }
  })
  
  # Remove NULLs
  effect_list <- effect_list[!sapply(effect_list, is.null)]
  
  if(length(effect_list) == 0) {
    return(list(
      cohens_d = NA, cohens_d_ci_low = NA, cohens_d_ci_high = NA,
      rank_biserial = NA, rank_bis_ci_low = NA, rank_bis_ci_high = NA,
      cramers_v = NA, cramers_ci_low = NA, cramers_ci_high = NA
    ))
  }
  
  # Pool effect sizes (average)
  if(!is_categorical) {
    list(
      cohens_d = mean(sapply(effect_list, function(x) x$cohens_d), na.rm = TRUE),
      cohens_d_ci_low = mean(sapply(effect_list, function(x) x$cohens_d_ci_low), na.rm = TRUE),
      cohens_d_ci_high = mean(sapply(effect_list, function(x) x$cohens_d_ci_high), na.rm = TRUE),
      rank_biserial = mean(sapply(effect_list, function(x) x$rank_biserial), na.rm = TRUE),
      rank_bis_ci_low = mean(sapply(effect_list, function(x) x$rank_bis_ci_low), na.rm = TRUE),
      rank_bis_ci_high = mean(sapply(effect_list, function(x) x$rank_bis_ci_high), na.rm = TRUE),
      cramers_v = NA, cramers_ci_low = NA, cramers_ci_high = NA
    )
  } else {
    list(
      cohens_d = NA, cohens_d_ci_low = NA, cohens_d_ci_high = NA,
      rank_biserial = NA, rank_bis_ci_low = NA, rank_bis_ci_high = NA,
      cramers_v = mean(sapply(effect_list, function(x) x$cramers_v), na.rm = TRUE),
      cramers_ci_low = mean(sapply(effect_list, function(x) x$cramers_ci_low), na.rm = TRUE),
      cramers_ci_high = mean(sapply(effect_list, function(x) x$cramers_ci_high), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
}

interpret_effect_size <- function(es_value, type = "cohens_d") {
  sapply(es_value, function(x) {
    if(is.na(x)) return("Cannot calculate")
    
    es_abs <- abs(x)
    
    if(type == "cohens_d") {
      if(es_abs < 0.2) return("Negligible")
      if(es_abs < 0.5) return("Small")
      if(es_abs < 0.8) return("Medium")
      return("Large")
    } else if(type == "cramers_v") {
      if(es_abs < 0.1) return("Negligible")
      if(es_abs < 0.3) return("Small")
      if(es_abs < 0.5) return("Medium")
      return("Large")
    } else if(type == "rank_biserial") {
      if(es_abs < 0.1) return("Negligible")
      if(es_abs < 0.3) return("Small")
      if(es_abs < 0.5) return("Medium")
      return("Large")
    }
  })
}

test_one_imputation <- function(var, data, group_var = "scrn_stopped_bzra", 
                                categorical_list = categorical_vars) {
  
  if(!is.factor(data[[group_var]])) {
    data[[group_var]] <- factor(data[[group_var]], 
                                 levels = c(0, 1),
                                 labels = c("Continuer", "Discontinuer"))
  }
  
  if(all(is.na(data[[var]]))) {
    return(list(var = var, test = "NA", statistic = NA, p = NA))
  }
  
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var)), !is.na(!!sym(group_var)))
  
  if(nrow(data_clean) < 10) {
    return(list(var = var, test = "Insufficient", statistic = NA, p = NA))
  }
  
  is_categorical <- var %in% categorical_list || 
                    is.character(data_clean[[var]]) || 
                    is.factor(data_clean[[var]])
  
  if(!is_categorical && is.numeric(data_clean[[var]])) {
    # Mann-Whitney U test
    test_result <- suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(as.formula(paste(var, "~", group_var)), 
                  data = data_clean, exact = FALSE)
    )
    
    return(list(
      var = var,
      test = "Mann-Whitney U",
      statistic = test_result$statistic,
      p = test_result$p.value
    ))
    
  } else {
    # Categorical test
    if(!is.factor(data_clean[[var]])) {
      data_clean[[var]] <- factor(data_clean[[var]])
    }
    
    tab <- table(data_clean[[group_var]], data_clean[[var]])
    
    if(any(dim(tab) == 0)) {
      return(list(var = var, test = "Invalid", statistic = NA, p = NA))
    }
    
    expected <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab)$expected)
    use_fisher <- any(expected < 5)
    
    if(use_fisher) {
      test_result <- tryCatch({
        suppressWarnings(
          fisher.test(tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        list(p.value = NA)
      })
      test_name <- "Fisher's Exact"
      statistic <- NA
      
    } else {
      test_result <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab))
      test_name <- "Chi-square"
      statistic <- test_result$statistic
    }
    
    return(list(
      var = var,
      test = test_name,
      statistic = statistic,
      p = test_result$p.value
    ))
  }
}

pool_test_results <- function(var, mids_obj, group_var = "scrn_stopped_bzra") {
  
  imp_results <- lapply(1:mids_obj$m, function(i) {
    data <- complete(mids_obj, i)
    
    if(!is.factor(data[[group_var]])) {
      data[[group_var]] <- factor(data[[group_var]], 
                                   levels = c(0, 1),
                                   labels = c("Continuer", "Discontinuer"))
    }
    
    test_one_imputation(var, data, group_var)
  })
  
  p_values <- sapply(imp_results, function(x) x$p)
  test_types <- sapply(imp_results, function(x) x$test)
  
  p_values_valid <- p_values[!is.na(p_values)]
  
  if(length(p_values_valid) == 0) {
    return(list(
      var = var,
      test = imp_results[[1]]$test,
      p_pooled = NA
    ))
  }
  
  p_pooled <- median(p_values_valid)
  test_type <- names(sort(table(test_types), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  
  return(list(
    var = var,
    test = test_type,
    p_pooled = p_pooled
  ))
}

#==============================================================================
# STEP 6: RUN ANALYSIS FOR ALL DOMAINS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 6: RUNNING COMPREHENSIVE ANALYSIS\n")
cat("FDR correction applied WITHIN each domain (family of tests)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

create_comprehensive_table <- function(variables, domain_name, mids_obj) {
  
  cat("Processing", domain_name, "domain (", length(variables), "variables)...\n")
  
  if(length(variables) == 0) {
    cat("  ⚠ WARNING: No variables in this domain!\n\n")
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  for(var in variables) {
    
    cat("  Analyzing:", var, "...\n")
    
    # Check if variable exists
    if(!var %in% names(complete(mids_obj, 1))) {
      cat("    ⚠ Variable not found, skipping...\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Determine if categorical
    is_cat <- var %in% categorical_vars
    
    # Get descriptive statistics
    tryCatch({
      if(!is_cat && is.numeric(complete(mids_obj, 1)[[var]])) {
        desc <- get_enhanced_continuous_desc(var, mids_obj)
        
        # Format for table
        desc_formatted <- desc %>%
          mutate(
            descriptive = paste0(
              round(mean, 2), " (", round(sd, 2), ")"
            )
          ) %>%
          select(group, descriptive) %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = descriptive)
        
      } else {
        desc <- get_enhanced_categorical_desc(var, mids_obj)
        
        # Format all categories
        desc_formatted <- desc %>%
          mutate(
            category_label = paste0(!!sym(var), ": ", round(n, 0), " (", round(pct, 1), "%)"),
            row_id = row_number()
          ) %>%
          select(group, category_label) %>%
          group_by(group) %>%
          summarise(descriptive = paste(category_label, collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop") %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = descriptive)
      }
      
      # Get statistical test
      test_result <- pool_test_results(var, mids_obj)
      
      # Get effect sizes
      effect_sizes <- calculate_enhanced_effect_sizes(var, mids_obj, is_categorical = is_cat)
      
      # Combine results
      result_row <- tibble(
        Variable = var,
        Type = ifelse(is_cat, "Categorical", "Continuous"),
        Continuer = desc_formatted$Continuer,
        Discontinuer = desc_formatted$Discontinuer,
        Test = test_result$test,
        p_value = test_result$p_pooled,
        Cohens_d = effect_sizes$cohens_d,
        Cohens_d_95CI = ifelse(!is.na(effect_sizes$cohens_d),
                               paste0("[", round(effect_sizes$cohens_d_ci_low, 2), ", ",
                                     round(effect_sizes$cohens_d_ci_high, 2), "]"),
                               NA),
        Rank_Biserial = effect_sizes$rank_biserial,
        Rank_Biserial_95CI = ifelse(!is.na(effect_sizes$rank_biserial),
                                    paste0("[", round(effect_sizes$rank_bis_ci_low, 2), ", ",
                                          round(effect_sizes$rank_bis_ci_high, 2), "]"),
                                    NA),
        Cramers_V = effect_sizes$cramers_v,
        Cramers_V_95CI = ifelse(!is.na(effect_sizes$cramers_v),
                               paste0("[", round(effect_sizes$cramers_ci_low, 2), ", ",
                                     round(effect_sizes$cramers_ci_high, 2), "]"),
                               NA)
      )
      
      results_list[[var]] <- result_row
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("    ✗ Error analyzing", var, ":", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  if(length(results_list) == 0) {
    cat("  ⚠ WARNING: No results generated for this domain!\n\n")
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  results_table <- bind_rows(results_list)
  
  # Apply FDR correction WITHIN THIS DOMAIN ONLY
  cat("  Applying FDR correction within", domain_name, "domain...\n")
  results_table <- results_table %>%
    mutate(
      q_value_domain = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      Significant_FDR = q_value_domain < 0.05
    )
  
  # Add effect size interpretations
  results_table <- results_table %>%
    mutate(
      Effect_Interpretation = case_when(
        !is.na(Cohens_d) ~ interpret_effect_size(Cohens_d, "cohens_d"),
        !is.na(Rank_Biserial) ~ interpret_effect_size(Rank_Biserial, "rank_biserial"),
        !is.na(Cramers_V) ~ interpret_effect_size(Cramers_V, "cramers_v"),
        TRUE ~ "N/A"
      )
    )
  
  # Arrange by significance
  results_table <- results_table %>%
    arrange(q_value_domain, p_value)
  
  cat("  ✓ Completed", domain_name, "domain\n")
  cat("    -", sum(results_table$Significant_FDR, na.rm = TRUE), 
      "variables significant after FDR correction\n\n")
  
  return(results_table)
}

# Create tables for each domain with error handling
cat("Creating Demographics table...\n")

})
```

## Hopkins Test

Measures the clusterability of the data

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# HOPKINS STATISTIC TEST FOR CLUSTERABILITY
# Dataset: imputed_data_with_subscales.rds
# Tests whether personality variables have clustering structure
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(clustertend)
library(factoextra)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("HOPKINS STATISTIC TEST FOR CLUSTERABILITY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD DATA
#==============================================================================

cat("STEP 1: Loading imputed data\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Load imputed data
mids_with_subscales <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")

cat("✓ Loaded mids object\n")
cat("  Number of imputations:", mids_with_subscales$m, "\n")
cat("  Total variables:", ncol(mids_with_subscales$data), "\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# STEP 2: EXTRACT COMPLETE DATA
#==============================================================================

cat("STEP 2: Extracting complete dataset (imputation 1)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

data_complete <- complete(mids_with_subscales, 1)

cat("✓ Extracted complete data\n")
cat("  Total observations:", nrow(data_complete), "\n")
cat("  Total variables:", ncol(data_complete), "\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# STEP 3: DEFINE PERSONALITY VARIABLES
#==============================================================================

cat("STEP 3: Identifying personality variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

all_vars <- names(data_complete)

# Define personality variables explicitly (16 variables total)
personality_vars <- c(
  # Big Five (5 variables)
  "BFI_Extraversion",
  "BFI_Agreeableness",
  "BFI_Conscientiousness",
  "BFI_Neuroticism",
  "BFI_Openness",
  
  # DBAS subscales only - excluding DBAS_Total (4 variables)
  "DBAS_Consequences",
  "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
  "DBAS_Expectations",
  "DBAS_Medications",
  
  # SURPS subscales (4 variables)
  "SURPS_Impulsivity",
  "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",
  "SURPS_Hopelessness",
  "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity",
  
  # CISS subscales (3 variables)
  "CISS_Task",
  "CISS_Emotion",
  "CISS_Avoidance"
)

# Check which variables actually exist in the data
available_personality <- intersect(personality_vars, all_vars)

cat("Personality variables found:\n")
cat("  Big Five:", sum(grepl("^BFI_", available_personality)), "\n")
cat("  DBAS subscales:", sum(grepl("^DBAS_", available_personality)), "(excluding DBAS_Total)\n")
cat("  SURPS:", sum(grepl("^SURPS_", available_personality)), "\n")
cat("  CISS:", sum(grepl("^CISS_", available_personality)), "\n")
cat("  Total:", length(available_personality), "variables\n\n")

if(length(available_personality) != 16) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: Expected 16 variables but found", length(available_personality), "\n\n")
}

cat("Variables included:\n")
for(var in available_personality) {
  cat("  -", var, "\n")
}
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# STEP 4: PREPARE DATA FOR CLUSTERING
#==============================================================================

cat("STEP 4: Preparing data for clustering analysis\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Select personality variables, standardize, and remove missing
X_std <- data_complete %>%
  select(all_of(available_personality)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), scale)) %>%
  drop_na()

cat("✓ Data prepared\n")
cat("  Observations after removing NA:", nrow(X_std), "\n")
cat("  Variables:", ncol(X_std), "\n")
cat("  Data is standardized (mean=0, sd=1)\n\n")

# Check for any remaining issues
if(nrow(X_std) < 50) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: Very few observations (n =", nrow(X_std), ")\n")
  cat("  Hopkins test may not be reliable with small samples\n\n")
}

if(ncol(X_std) < 2) {
  stop("ERROR: Need at least 2 variables for clustering analysis")
}

#==============================================================================
# STEP 5: HOPKINS STATISTIC TEST
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 5: HOPKINS STATISTIC TEST\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Computing Hopkins statistic...\n")
cat("(This may take a moment with large datasets)\n\n")

# Calculate Hopkins statistic
# Using n = nrow(X_std) - 1 as sample size
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
hopkins_result <- hopkins(X_std, n = nrow(X_std) - 1)

cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("HOPKINS STATISTIC RESULT\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

cat("Hopkins Statistic (H):", round(hopkins_result$H, 4), "\n\n")

cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
if(hopkins_result$H > 0.75) {
  cat("  ✓ STRONG clustering tendency (H > 0.75)\n")
  cat("    → Data has clear cluster structure\n")
  cat("    → Clustering analysis is highly appropriate\n")
} else if(hopkins_result$H > 0.5) {
  cat("  ✓ MODERATE clustering tendency (0.5 < H < 0.75)\n")
  cat("    → Data has some cluster structure\n")
  cat("    → Clustering analysis is reasonable\n")
} else if(hopkins_result$H > 0.3) {
  cat("  ⚠ WEAK clustering tendency (0.3 < H < 0.5)\n")
  cat("    → Data is close to random/uniform\n")
  cat("    → Clustering may not reveal meaningful groups\n")
} else {
  cat("  ✗ NO clustering tendency (H < 0.3)\n")
  cat("    → Data appears random/uniform\n")
  cat("    → Clustering is NOT recommended\n")
}

cat("\n")
cat("GUIDELINES:\n")
cat("  • H close to 1.0: Highly clusterable data\n")
cat("  • H close to 0.5: Random/uniform data (no clusters)\n")
cat("  • H close to 0.0: Regularly spaced data\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# STEP 6: VISUAL ASSESSMENT - DISTANCE MATRIX
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 6: VISUAL ASSESSMENT - DISTANCE MATRIX HEATMAP\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Computing distance matrix and creating heatmap...\n")
cat("(This may take a moment with large datasets)\n\n")

# Compute distance matrix
dist_matrix <- dist(X_std)

# Create distance matrix heatmap
p1 <- fviz_dist(dist_matrix, show_labels = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distance Matrix Heatmap - Personality Variables",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Hopkins Statistic = ", round(hopkins_result$H, 3), 
      " | n = ", nrow(X_std), " observations, ", ncol(X_std), " variables"
    ),
    caption = "Distinct blocks = clear clusters | Smooth gradient = continuous data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# Display plot
print(p1)

# Save plot
ggsave("hopkins_distance_heatmap.png", p1, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved: hopkins_distance_heatmap.png\n\n")

cat("VISUAL INTERPRETATION:\n")
cat("  • Distinct blocks/squares → Clear cluster structure\n")
cat("  • Smooth gradient → Continuous/uniform data\n")
cat("  • Dark regions → Similar observations (low distance)\n")
cat("  • Light regions → Dissimilar observations (high distance)\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# STEP 7: ADDITIONAL DIAGNOSTICS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 7: ADDITIONAL DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Summary statistics of distances
dist_values <- as.vector(dist_matrix)

cat("Distance matrix statistics:\n")
cat("  Mean distance:", round(mean(dist_values), 3), "\n")
cat("  SD of distances:", round(sd(dist_values), 3), "\n")
cat("  Min distance:", round(min(dist_values), 3), "\n")
cat("  Max distance:", round(max(dist_values), 3), "\n")
cat("  Median distance:", round(median(dist_values), 3), "\n\n")

# Create histogram of distances
p2 <- ggplot(data.frame(distance = dist_values), aes(x = distance)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(dist_values), color = "red", 
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Pairwise Distances",
    subtitle = paste0("Mean distance = ", round(mean(dist_values), 2)),
    x = "Euclidean Distance",
    y = "Frequency",
    caption = "Bimodal distribution suggests distinct clusters"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p2)

ggsave("hopkins_distance_distribution.png", p2, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved: hopkins_distance_distribution.png\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# SUMMARY
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Dataset: imputed_data_with_subscales.rds\n")
cat("Observations analyzed:", nrow(X_std), "\n")
cat("Personality variables:", ncol(X_std), "\n")
cat("Hopkins Statistic:", round(hopkins_result$H, 4), "\n\n")

cat("CONCLUSION:\n")
if(hopkins_result$H > 0.5) {
  cat("  The data shows clustering tendency (H > 0.5)\n")
  cat("  → Proceed with cluster analysis\n")
  cat("  → Consider k-means, hierarchical, or other clustering methods\n")
} else {
  cat("  The data does NOT show strong clustering tendency (H ≤ 0.5)\n")
  cat("  → Clustering may not reveal meaningful groups\n")
  cat("  → Consider alternative approaches (regression, factor analysis, etc.)\n")
}

cat("\n")
cat("OUTPUT FILES:\n")
cat("  1. hopkins_distance_heatmap.png\n")
cat("  2. hopkins_distance_distribution.png\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```





## Dimensional Personality Regression Analysis

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# COMPREHENSIVE DIMENSIONAL PERSONALITY REGRESSION ANALYSIS (FIXED)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Test personality dimensions as continuous predictors of BZRA cessation
# Updates: Fixed composite score calculation
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(mediation)
library(broom)

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DIMENSIONAL PERSONALITY REGRESSION ANALYSIS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART 1: LOAD DATA
#==============================================================================
cat("PART 1: DATA PREPARATION\n\n")

mids_with_subscales <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
m <- mids_with_subscales$m
cat("Number of imputations:", m, "\n\n")

# Outcome variable
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

# VERIFICATION: Check that outcome variable exists in the imputed data
cat("Verifying outcome variable...\n")
first_complete <- complete(mids_with_subscales, 1)
all_vars <- names(first_complete)

if(outcome_var %in% all_vars) {
  cat("✓ Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' found in completed data\n", sep = "")
  cat("  - Class:", class(first_complete[[outcome_var]]), "\n")
  cat("  - Distribution:", table(first_complete[[outcome_var]]), "\n\n")
  
  # Check if outcome is in the mids object's original data
  if(!(outcome_var %in% names(mids_with_subscales$data))) {
    cat("⚠ Outcome variable not in mids$data - adding it now...\n")
    
    # Add outcome to mids$data
    mids_with_subscales$data[[outcome_var]] <- first_complete[[outcome_var]]
    cat("✓ Outcome variable added to mids$data\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ Outcome variable already in mids$data\n\n")
  }
} else {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' NOT FOUND in imputed data!")
}

#==============================================================================
# PART 2: IDENTIFY AVAILABLE VARIABLES
#==============================================================================
cat("PART 2: Identifying available personality variables\n\n")

all_vars <- names(complete(mids_with_subscales, 1))

# Personality variables
big_five <- c("BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Agreeableness", "BFI_Conscientiousness", 
              "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Openness")
dbas_vars <- grep("^DBAS_", all_vars, value = TRUE)
surps_vars <- grep("^SURPS_", all_vars, value = TRUE)
ciss_vars <- grep("^CISS_", all_vars, value = TRUE)

cat("Available personality variables:\n")
cat("  Big Five:", sum(big_five %in% all_vars), "/", length(big_five), "\n")
cat("  DBAS:", length(dbas_vars), "\n")
cat("  SURPS:", length(surps_vars), "\n")
cat("  CISS:", length(ciss_vars), "\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART 3: PREPARE DATA WITH PERSONALITY SUBSCALES
#==============================================================================
cat("PART 3: Preparing data with personality subscales\n\n")

# Define personality subscales (16 variables - same as Hopkins test)
personality_vars <- c(
  # Big Five (5 variables)
  "BFI_Extraversion",
  "BFI_Agreeableness",
  "BFI_Conscientiousness",
  "BFI_Neuroticism",
  "BFI_Openness",
  
  # DBAS subscales only - excluding DBAS_Total (4 variables)
  "DBAS_Consequences",
  "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
  "DBAS_Expectations",
  "DBAS_Medications",
  
  # SURPS subscales (4 variables)
  "SURPS_Impulsivity",
  "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",
  "SURPS_Hopelessness",
  "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity",
  
  # CISS subscales (3 variables)
  "CISS_Task",
  "CISS_Emotion",
  "CISS_Avoidance"
)

# Define demographic and clinical confounders
demo_vars <- c("age", "sex", "education_level")
clinical_vars <- c("phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "n_health_conditions")

cat("Preparing data with education recoding...\n\n")

# Note: Data preparation will be done after converting to long format to preserve outcome variable

# Get original data and bind with imputations
cat("Converting to long format with original data...\n")

# Method 1: Use complete() with action="long" to preserve all variables
long_data <- complete(mids_with_subscales, action = "long", include = TRUE)

cat("Data structure:\n")
cat("  Total rows:", nrow(long_data), "\n")
cat("  Total columns:", ncol(long_data), "\n")
cat("  Number of imputations:", max(long_data$.imp), "\n")

# Verify outcome is present
if(outcome_var %in% names(long_data)) {
  cat("  ✓ Outcome variable present in long_data\n\n")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable lost during conversion to long format!")
}

# Add education recoding to long data
cat("Adding education recoding to long data...\n")
long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Recode education_level
    education_level = case_when(
      education %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "High School or Less",
      education %in% c(4, 5) ~ "University/Trade School",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    education_level = factor(education_level, 
                             levels = c("High School or Less", "University/Trade School")),
    
    # Convert to numeric for modeling
    education_level_numeric = as.numeric(education_level) - 1  # 0 = HS or less, 1 = Univ/Trade
  )

# Convert back to mids
mids_composite <- as.mids(long_data)

# CRITICAL: Ensure outcome is in mids_composite$data
cat("Ensuring outcome variable is in mids object...\n")
if(!(outcome_var %in% names(mids_composite$data))) {
  cat("  Adding", outcome_var, "to mids$data\n")
  mids_composite$data[[outcome_var]] <- first_complete[[outcome_var]]
  cat("  ✓ Added\n")
} else {
  cat("  ✓ Already present\n")
}

# Double check by testing on first imputation
test_data <- complete(mids_composite, 1)
if(!(outcome_var %in% names(test_data))) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable still missing after all fixes!")
}

cat("✓ Converted to mids object with outcome variable\n\n")

# Also create list for descriptives
composite_list <- lapply(1:m, function(i) {
  complete(mids_composite, i)
})

#==============================================================================
# PART 4: DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
#==============================================================================
cat("PART 4: DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS\n\n")

desc_data <- composite_list[[1]]
cat("Total N:", nrow(desc_data), "\n")
cat("Discontinuation rate:", 
    round(100 * mean(desc_data$scrn_stopped_bzra, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n\n")

cat("Personality subscales included (n=16):\n")
for(var in personality_vars) {
  cat("  -", var, "\n")
}
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART 5: HIERARCHICAL REGRESSION
#==============================================================================
cat("PART 5: HIERARCHICAL REGRESSION MODELS\n\n")

# Create list of complete datasets for manual fitting
cat("Preparing data for regression...\n")
imputed_datasets <- lapply(1:m, function(i) {
  long_data %>% filter(.imp == i)
})

# Verify outcome is in each dataset
cat("Verifying outcome variable in all imputations...\n")
outcome_check <- sapply(imputed_datasets, function(d) outcome_var %in% names(d))
if(!all(outcome_check)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable missing from some imputations!")
}
cat("✓ Outcome variable present in all", m, "imputations\n\n")

# Model 1: Personality subscales only (16 variables)
cat("Fitting Model 1: Personality subscales only (16 predictors)...\n")
formula_m1 <- as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", paste(personality_vars, collapse = " + ")))

fit_m1_list <- lapply(imputed_datasets, function(data) {
  glm(formula_m1, data = data, family = binomial)
})

# Pool results manually using Rubin's rules
pooled_m1 <- pool(as.mira(fit_m1_list))
summary_m1 <- summary(pooled_m1)

# Model 2: + Demographics
cat("Fitting Model 2: + Demographics...\n")
demo_vars_model <- c("age", "sex", "education_level_numeric")
formula_m2 <- as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", 
                               paste(c(personality_vars, demo_vars_model), collapse = " + ")))

fit_m2_list <- lapply(imputed_datasets, function(data) {
  glm(formula_m2, data = data, family = binomial)
})

pooled_m2 <- pool(as.mira(fit_m2_list))
summary_m2 <- summary(pooled_m2)

# Model 3: + Clinical
cat("Fitting Model 3: + Clinical factors...\n")
formula_m3 <- as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", 
                               paste(c(personality_vars, demo_vars_model, clinical_vars), 
                                     collapse = " + ")))

fit_m3_list <- lapply(imputed_datasets, function(data) {
  glm(formula_m3, data = data, family = binomial)
})

pooled_m3 <- pool(as.mira(fit_m3_list))
summary_m3 <- summary(pooled_m3)

cat("✓ All models fitted\n\n")

# Calculate ORs
calc_or_table <- function(pooled_summary, model_name) {
  pooled_summary %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      OR = exp(estimate),
      CI_Lower = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
      CI_Upper = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
      Model = model_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Model, term, OR, CI_Lower, CI_Upper, p.value)
}

or_m1 <- calc_or_table(summary_m1, "Model 1")
or_m2 <- calc_or_table(summary_m2, "Model 2")
or_m3 <- calc_or_table(summary_m3, "Model 3")

cat("MODEL 3 RESULTS (FULL MODEL):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")
print(as.data.frame(or_m3), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART 6: VIF CHECK
#==============================================================================
cat("PART 6: MULTICOLLINEARITY CHECK\n\n")

data_vif <- composite_list[[1]] %>%
  drop_na(scrn_stopped_bzra, all_of(c(personality_vars, demo_vars_model, clinical_vars)))

model_vif <- glm(formula_m3, data = data_vif, family = binomial)
vif_values <- vif(model_vif)

cat("VIF VALUES:\n")
print(round(vif_values, 2))
cat("\n")

if(max(vif_values) > 10) {
  cat("⚠ WARNING: Serious multicollinearity (VIF > 10)\n\n")
} else if(max(vif_values) > 5) {
  cat("⚠ CAUTION: Moderate multicollinearity (VIF > 5)\n\n")
} else {
  cat("✓ No serious multicollinearity\n\n")
}

#==============================================================================
# PART 7: INTERACTION SCREENING
#==============================================================================
cat("PART 7: INTERACTION SCREENING\n\n")

all_confounders <- c(demo_vars_model, clinical_vars)
interaction_terms <- expand.grid(
  Personality = personality_vars,
  Confounder = all_confounders,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Interaction = paste(Personality, Confounder, sep = ":"))

cat("Testing", nrow(interaction_terms), "interactions...\n")
cat("(This may take a few minutes)\n\n")

interaction_results <- data.frame()

for(i in 1:nrow(interaction_terms)) {
  pers <- interaction_terms$Personality[i]
  conf <- interaction_terms$Confounder[i]
  
  formula_int <- as.formula(paste(
    "scrn_stopped_bzra ~",
    paste(c(personality_vars, all_confounders), collapse = " + "),
    "+", pers, "*", conf
  ))
  
  # Fit to each imputed dataset
  fit_int_list <- lapply(imputed_datasets, function(data) {
    glm(formula_int, data = data, family = binomial)
  })
  
  # Pool results
  pooled_int <- pool(as.mira(fit_int_list))
  summary_int <- summary(pooled_int)
  
  int_term <- paste(pers, conf, sep = ":")
  p_val <- summary_int$p.value[summary_int$term == int_term]
  
  if(length(p_val) > 0) {
    interaction_results <- bind_rows(interaction_results, data.frame(
      Personality = pers,
      Confounder = conf,
      Interaction = int_term,
      p_value = p_val,
      Significant = p_val < 0.10
    ))
  }
}

sig_interactions <- interaction_results %>% filter(Significant) %>% arrange(p_value)

if(nrow(sig_interactions) > 0) {
  cat("SIGNIFICANT INTERACTIONS (p < 0.10):\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")
  print(as.data.frame(sig_interactions), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("No significant interactions detected\n\n")
}

#==============================================================================
# PART 8: MEDIATION ANALYSIS (REMOVED)
#==============================================================================
# Note: Mediation analysis removed as ADL, side effects, safety, and dependence
# measure different constructs and should not be combined into composites.
# If mediation is needed, test individual mediators separately.

#==============================================================================
# PART 9: SAVE RESULTS
#==============================================================================
cat("PART 8: SAVING RESULTS\n\n")

results_list <- list(
  sample_size = nrow(desc_data),
  model1 = summary_m1,
  model2 = summary_m2,
  model3 = summary_m3,
  or_model3 = or_m3,
  vif_values = vif_values,
  interactions = interaction_results,
  n_imputations = m
)

saveRDS(results_list, "dimensional_regression_results.rds")
write.csv(or_m3, "dimensional_model3_odds_ratios.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(interaction_results, "dimensional_interaction_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("✓ Results saved\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# SUMMARY
#==============================================================================
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

sig_personality <- or_m3 %>%
  filter(grepl(paste(personality_vars, collapse = "|"), term), p.value < 0.05)

if(nrow(sig_personality) > 0) {
  cat("SIGNIFICANT PERSONALITY PREDICTORS:\n")
  print(sig_personality[,c("term", "OR", "CI_Lower", "CI_Upper", "p.value")], 
        row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
} else {
  cat("No significant personality predictors\n")
}

cat("\nOUTPUT FILES:\n")
cat("  • dimensional_regression_results.rds\n")
cat("  • dimensional_model3_odds_ratios.csv\n")
cat("  • dimensional_interaction_results.csv\n\n")
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

  "BFI_Conscientiousness",

big_five <- c("BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Agreeableness", "BFI_Conscientiousness",

#==============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
#==============================================================================

# Fit and evaluate Random Forest
fit_rf <- function(data, predictors, outcome, test_prop = 0.2) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    select(all_of(c(outcome, predictors))) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    mutate(!!outcome := factor(.data[[outcome]], 
                              levels = c(0, 1),
                              labels = c("Still_Using", "Discontinued")))
  
  if(nrow(model_data) < 50) {
    return(list(auc = NA, n = nrow(model_data), error = "Insufficient data"))
  }
  
  set.seed(123)
  train_idx <- createDataPartition(model_data[[outcome]], p = 1 - test_prop, list = FALSE)
  train_data <- model_data[train_idx, ]
  test_data <- model_data[-train_idx, ]
  
  rf_model <- tryCatch({
    randomForest(
      as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ .")),
      data = train_data,
      ntree = 1000,
      importance = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if(is.null(rf_model)) {
    return(list(auc = NA, n = nrow(model_data), error = "Model failed"))
  }
  
  pred_prob <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type = "prob")[, "Discontinued"]
  roc_obj <- roc(test_data[[outcome]], pred_prob, quiet = TRUE)
  
  return(list(
    auc = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)),
    n = nrow(model_data),
    n_train = nrow(train_data),
    n_test = nrow(test_data),
    error = NULL
  ))
}

# Fit and evaluate Logistic Regression
fit_lr <- function(data, predictors, outcome, test_prop = 0.2) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    select(all_of(c(outcome, predictors))) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    mutate(!!outcome := factor(.data[[outcome]], 
                              levels = c(0, 1),
                              labels = c("Still_Using", "Discontinued")))
  
  if(nrow(model_data) < 50) {
    return(list(auc = NA, n = nrow(model_data), error = "Insufficient data"))
  }
  
  set.seed(123)
  train_idx <- createDataPartition(model_data[[outcome]], p = 1 - test_prop, list = FALSE)
  train_data <- model_data[train_idx, ]
  test_data <- model_data[-train_idx, ]
  
  lr_model <- tryCatch({
    glm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ .")),
        data = train_data,
        family = binomial)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if(is.null(lr_model)) {
    return(list(auc = NA, n = nrow(model_data), error = "Model failed"))
  }
  
  pred_prob <- predict(lr_model, test_data, type = "response")
  roc_obj <- roc(test_data[[outcome]], pred_prob, quiet = TRUE)
  
  return(list(
    auc = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)),
    n = nrow(model_data),
    error = NULL
  ))
}

# Fit and evaluate XGBoost
fit_xgb <- function(data, predictors, outcome, test_prop = 0.2) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    select(all_of(c(outcome, predictors))) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # Convert factors to numeric
  for(col in names(model_data)) {
    if(is.factor(model_data[[col]]) && col != outcome) {
      model_data[[col]] <- as.numeric(model_data[[col]])
    }
  }
  
  model_data <- model_data %>%
    mutate(!!outcome := as.numeric(as.factor(.data[[outcome]])) - 1)
  
  if(nrow(model_data) < 50) {
    return(list(auc = NA, n = nrow(model_data), error = "Insufficient data"))
  }
  
  set.seed(123)
  train_idx <- createDataPartition(model_data[[outcome]], p = 1 - test_prop, list = FALSE)
  train_data <- model_data[train_idx, ]
  test_data <- model_data[-train_idx, ]
  
  # Prepare matrices
  train_x <- as.matrix(train_data %>% select(-all_of(outcome)))
  train_y <- train_data[[outcome]]
  test_x <- as.matrix(test_data %>% select(-all_of(outcome)))
  test_y <- test_data[[outcome]]
  
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = train_x, label = train_y)
  dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = test_x, label = test_y)
  
  xgb_model <- tryCatch({
    xgboost(
      data = dtrain,
      nrounds = 100,
      objective = "binary:logistic",
      eval_metric = "auc",
      verbose = 0
    )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if(is.null(xgb_model)) {
    return(list(auc = NA, n = nrow(model_data), error = "Model failed"))
  }
  
  pred_prob <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)
  roc_obj <- roc(test_y, pred_prob, quiet = TRUE)
  
  return(list(
    auc = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)),
    n = nrow(model_data),
    error = NULL
  ))
}

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    education_level = factor(education_level, 
                             levels = c("High School or Less", "University/Trade School")),
    education_level_numeric = as.numeric(education_level) - 1
  )

cat("Recreating subscales in original pre-imputation data...\n")

# Check if raw items exist in original data
bfi_items <- c("reserved", "outgoing", "find_fault", "trusting", "lazy", "thorough", 
               "relaxed", "nervous", "few_interests", "imagination")
surps_items <- paste0("surps", 1:23)
dbas_items <- c("dbas1", paste0("dbas_", 2:16))
ciss_items <- paste0("ciss", 1:21)

items_available <- c(
  sum(bfi_items %in% names(SIMOA_original)),
  sum(surps_items %in% names(SIMOA_original)),
  sum(dbas_items %in% names(SIMOA_original)),
  sum(ciss_items %in% names(SIMOA_original))
)

cat("  BFI items available:", items_available[1], "/", length(bfi_items), "\n")
cat("  SURPS items available:", items_available[2], "/", length(surps_items), "\n")
cat("  DBAS items available:", items_available[3], "/", length(dbas_items), "\n")
cat("  CISS items available:", items_available[4], "/", length(ciss_items), "\n\n")

if(sum(items_available) >= 30) {
  
  cat("Sufficient raw items found - recreating subscales...\n")
  
  # Recreate BFI subscales (MEAN SCORES)
  if(all(c("reserved", "outgoing") %in% names(SIMOA_original))) {
    SIMOA_original$BFI_Extraversion <- rowMeans(
      SIMOA_original[, c("reserved", "outgoing")], na.rm = FALSE)
  }
  if(all(c("find_fault", "trusting") %in% names(SIMOA_original))) {
    SIMOA_original$BFI_Agreeableness <- rowMeans(
      SIMOA_original[, c("find_fault", "trusting")], na.rm = FALSE)
  }
  if(all(c("lazy", "thorough") %in% names(SIMOA_original))) {
    SIMOA_original$BFI_Conscientiousness <- rowMeans(
      SIMOA_original[, c("lazy", "thorough")], na.rm = FALSE)
  }
  if(all(c("relaxed", "nervous") %in% names(SIMOA_original))) {
    SIMOA_original$BFI_Neuroticism <- rowMeans(
      SIMOA_original[, c("relaxed", "nervous")], na.rm = FALSE)
  }
  if(all(c("few_interests", "imagination") %in% names(SIMOA_original))) {
    SIMOA_original$BFI_Openness <- rowMeans(
      SIMOA_original[, c("few_interests", "imagination")], na.rm = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Recreate SURPS subscales (MEAN SCORES)
  surps_subscales <- list(
    SURPS_Impulsivity = paste0("surps", c(2, 5, 11, 15, 22)),
    SURPS_Sensation_Seeking = paste0("surps", c(3, 6, 9, 12, 16, 19)),
    SURPS_Hopelessness = paste0("surps", c(1, 4, 7, 13, 17, 20, 23)),
    SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity = paste0("surps", c(8, 10, 14, 18, 21))
  )
  
  for(subscale_name in names(surps_subscales)) {
    items <- surps_subscales[[subscale_name]]
    if(all(items %in% names(SIMOA_original))) {
      SIMOA_original[[subscale_name]] <- rowMeans(
        SIMOA_original[, items], na.rm = FALSE)
    }
  }
  
  # Recreate DBAS subscales (MEAN SCORES)
  dbas_subscales <- list(
    DBAS_Consequences = paste0("dbas_", c(5, 7, 9, 12, 16)),
    DBAS_Worry_Helplessness = paste0("dbas_", c(3, 4, 8, 10, 11, 14)),
    DBAS_Expectations = c("dbas1", "dbas_2"),
    DBAS_Medications = paste0("dbas_", c(6, 13, 15))
  )
  
  for(subscale_name in names(dbas_subscales)) {
    items <- dbas_subscales[[subscale_name]]
    if(all(items %in% names(SIMOA_original))) {
      SIMOA_original[[subscale_name]] <- rowMeans(
        SIMOA_original[, items], na.rm = FALSE)
    }
  }
  
  # Recreate CISS subscales (MEAN SCORES)
  ciss_subscales <- list(
    CISS_Task = paste0("ciss", c(2, 6, 8, 11, 13, 16, 19)),
    CISS_Emotion = paste0("ciss", c(3, 5, 10, 12, 14, 17, 20)),
    CISS_Avoidance = paste0("ciss", c(1, 4, 7, 9, 15, 18, 21))
  )
  
  for(subscale_name in names(ciss_subscales)) {
    items <- ciss_subscales[[subscale_name]]
    if(all(items %in% names(SIMOA_original))) {
      SIMOA_original[[subscale_name]] <- rowMeans(
        SIMOA_original[, items], na.rm = FALSE)
    }
  }
  
  cat("✓ Subscales recreated in original data\n\n")
  
  # Now check which predictors are available
  available_predictors <- intersect(all_predictors, names(SIMOA_original))
  missing_predictors <- setdiff(all_predictors, names(SIMOA_original))
  
  cat("Predictors available in original data:", length(available_predictors), "/", length(all_predictors), "\n")
  if(length(missing_predictors) > 0 && length(missing_predictors) <= 5) {
    cat("  Missing:", paste(missing_predictors, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # Proceed with complete-case analysis
  if(outcome_var %in% names(SIMOA_original) && length(available_predictors) >= 15) {
    
    complete_case_data <- SIMOA_original %>%
      select(all_of(c(outcome_var, available_predictors))) %>%
      drop_na()
    
    n_imputed <- nrow(baseline_data %>% select(all_of(c(outcome_var, all_predictors))) %>% drop_na())
    n_complete <- nrow(complete_case_data)
    
    cat("Sample sizes:\n")
    cat("  Multiple imputation:", n_imputed, "\n")
    cat("  Complete-case:", n_complete, "\n")
    cat("  Loss:", n_imputed - n_complete, 
        "(", round(100 * (n_imputed - n_complete) / n_imputed, 1), "%)\n\n")
    
    if(n_complete >= 50) {
      cc_result <- fit_rf(complete_case_data, available_predictors, outcome_var)
      
      cat("RESULTS:\n")
      cat("  MI AUC:", round(baseline_auc, 3), "\n")
      cat("  Complete-case AUC:", round(cc_result$auc, 3), "\n")
      cat("  Difference:", round(abs(baseline_auc - cc_result$auc), 3), "\n\n")
      
      assessment <- ifelse(abs(baseline_auc - cc_result$auc) < 0.05, "Robust", "Concerning")
      
      all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
        Analysis = "Complete-Case",
        AUC = cc_result$auc,
        Difference = cc_result$auc - baseline_auc,
        Assessment = assessment,
        Details = paste0("n=", n_complete, ", ", length(available_predictors), " predictors")
      ))
      
      sensitivity_results$complete_case <- cc_result
      
      if(assessment == "Robust") {
        cat("✓ ROBUST: Multiple imputation did not substantially alter findings\n\n")
      } else {
        cat("⚠ CONCERNING: Results differ substantially from complete-case analysis\n")
        cat("  This suggests missing data may have influenced findings\n\n")
      }
      
    } else {
      cat("✗ Insufficient complete cases (n=", n_complete, ")\n\n")
      all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
        Analysis = "Complete-Case",
        AUC = NA,
        Difference = NA,
        Assessment = "Insufficient data",
        Details = paste0("n=", n_complete)
      ))
    }
  } else {
    cat("✗ Cannot perform complete-case analysis - outcome or insufficient predictors\n\n")
    all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
      Analysis = "Complete-Case",
      AUC = NA,
      Difference = NA,
      Assessment = "Data unavailable",
      Details = "Insufficient predictors after subscale recreation"
    ))
  }
  
} else {
  cat("✗ Insufficient raw items in original data to recreate subscales\n")
  cat("  Complete-case analysis not possible\n\n")
  all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
    Analysis = "Complete-Case",
    AUC = NA,
    Difference = NA,
    Assessment = "Cannot recreate subscales",
    Details = "Raw items not available in original data"
  ))
}

#==============================================================================
# 2. INDIVIDUAL PERSONALITY TRAIT EXCLUSION
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("TEST 2: INDIVIDUAL PERSONALITY TRAIT EXCLUSION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Testing exclusion of each Big Five trait individually...\n\n")

trait_exclusion_results <- data.frame()

for(trait in big_five) {
  cat("  Excluding:", trait, "...\n")
  
  predictors_without <- setdiff(all_predictors, trait)
  result <- fit_rf(baseline_data, predictors_without, outcome_var)
  
  if(!is.na(result$auc)) {
    diff <- result$auc - baseline_auc
    assessment <- ifelse(abs(diff) < 0.03, "Robust", 
                        ifelse(abs(diff) < 0.05, "Acceptable", "Concerning"))
    
    trait_exclusion_results <- bind_rows(trait_exclusion_results, data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      AUC = result$auc,
      Difference = diff,
      Assessment = assessment
    ))
    
    all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
      Analysis = paste0("Without ", trait),
      AUC = result$auc,
      Difference = diff,
      Assessment = assessment,
      Details = ""
    ))
  }
}

cat("\nRESULTS:\n")
print(trait_exclusion_results, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
cat("\n")

critical_traits <- trait_exclusion_results %>% 
  filter(Assessment == "Concerning")

if(nrow(critical_traits) > 0) {
  cat("⚠ CRITICAL TRAITS (removal changes AUC >0.05):\n")
  cat("  ", paste(critical_traits$Trait, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
} else {
  cat("✓ No single trait is driving the results\n\n")
}

sensitivity_results$trait_exclusion <- trait_exclusion_results

# 3. MODEL TYPE COMPARISON
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("TEST 3: MODEL TYPE COMPARISON\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Testing Random Forest vs Logistic Regression vs XGBoost...\n\n")

# Logistic Regression
cat("  Fitting Logistic Regression...\n")
lr_result <- fit_lr(baseline_data, all_predictors, outcome_var)

# XGBoost
cat("  Fitting XGBoost...\n")
xgb_result <- fit_xgb(baseline_data, all_predictors, outcome_var)

cat("\nRESULTS:\n")
cat("  Random Forest AUC:", round(baseline_auc, 3), "\n")
cat("  Logistic Regression AUC:", round(lr_result$auc, 3), "\n")
cat("  XGBoost AUC:", round(xgb_result$auc, 3), "\n\n")

# Add to results
all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
  Analysis = "Logistic Regression",
  AUC = lr_result$auc,
  Difference = lr_result$auc - baseline_auc,
  Assessment = ifelse(abs(lr_result$auc - baseline_auc) < 0.05, "Robust", "Different"),
  Details = "Alternative algorithm"
))

all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
  Analysis = "XGBoost",
  AUC = xgb_result$auc,
  Difference = xgb_result$auc - baseline_auc,
  Assessment = ifelse(abs(xgb_result$auc - baseline_auc) < 0.05, "Robust", "Different"),
  Details = "Alternative algorithm"
))

auc_range <- max(c(baseline_auc, lr_result$auc, xgb_result$auc), na.rm = TRUE) - 
             min(c(baseline_auc, lr_result$auc, xgb_result$auc), na.rm = TRUE)

if(auc_range < 0.05) {
  cat("✓ ROBUST: Results consistent across algorithms (range < 0.05)\n\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠ ALGORITHM-SENSITIVE: Results vary across methods\n\n")
}

sensitivity_results$model_comparison <- list(
  rf = baseline_auc,
  lr = lr_result$auc,
  xgb = xgb_result$auc
)

#==============================================================================
# 4. OUTLIER REMOVAL
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("TEST 4: OUTLIER REMOVAL\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Identify continuous variables
continuous_vars <- all_predictors[sapply(baseline_data[, all_predictors], is.numeric)]

if(length(continuous_vars) > 0) {
  
  cat("Identifying univariate outliers (>3 SD) on", length(continuous_vars), "continuous variables...\n\n")
  
  # Count outliers per variable
  outlier_counts <- sapply(continuous_vars, function(var) {
    values <- baseline_data[[var]]
    z_scores <- abs(scale(values))
    sum(z_scores > 3, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  cat("Variables with most outliers:\n")
  top_outliers <- sort(outlier_counts, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(5, length(outlier_counts))]
  for(i in seq_along(top_outliers)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %d outliers (%.1f%%)\n", 
                names(top_outliers)[i], 
                top_outliers[i],
                100 * top_outliers[i] / nrow(baseline_data)))
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # More lenient approach: Remove cases with extreme outliers on MULTIPLE variables
  # Define "extreme case" as having outliers (>3 SD) on 3+ variables
  outlier_flags_per_row <- apply(baseline_data[, continuous_vars, drop = FALSE], 1, function(row) {
    sum(abs(scale(row)) > 3, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  # Flag cases with 3+ extreme values
  extreme_cases <- outlier_flags_per_row >= 3
  n_extreme <- sum(extreme_cases)
  
  cat("Multivariate outlier assessment:\n")
  cat("  Cases with 1 outlier:", sum(outlier_flags_per_row == 1), "\n")
  cat("  Cases with 2 outliers:", sum(outlier_flags_per_row == 2), "\n")
  cat("  Cases with 3+ outliers (extreme):", n_extreme, 
      "(", round(100 * n_extreme / nrow(baseline_data), 1), "%)\n\n")
  
  if(n_extreme > 0 && n_extreme < nrow(baseline_data) * 0.15) {
    
    data_no_outliers <- baseline_data[!extreme_cases, ]
    outlier_result <- fit_rf(data_no_outliers, all_predictors, outcome_var)
    
    cat("RESULTS:\n")
    cat("  With outliers AUC:", round(baseline_auc, 3), "(n=", nrow(baseline_data), ")\n")
    cat("  Without extreme cases AUC:", round(outlier_result$auc, 3), "(n=", outlier_result$n, ")\n")
    cat("  Difference:", round(abs(baseline_auc - outlier_result$auc), 3), "\n\n")
    
    assessment <- ifelse(abs(baseline_auc - outlier_result$auc) < 0.03, "Robust", "Sensitive")
    
    all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
      Analysis = "Without Extreme Cases",
      AUC = outlier_result$auc,
      Difference = outlier_result$auc - baseline_auc,
      Assessment = assessment,
      Details = paste0(n_extreme, " extreme cases removed (3+ outliers)")
    ))
    
    sensitivity_results$outlier <- outlier_result
    
    if(assessment == "Robust") {
      cat("✓ ROBUST: Results not driven by extreme cases\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("⚠ SENSITIVE: Results change when extreme cases removed\n")
      cat("  Consider examining these cases for data quality issues\n\n")
    }
    
  } else if(n_extreme == 0) {
    cat("✓ No multivariate extreme cases detected\n")
    cat("  Model handles the observed range of values well\n\n")
    all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
      Analysis = "Without Extreme Cases",
      AUC = NA,
      Difference = NA,
      Assessment = "No extreme cases",
      Details = "No multivariate outliers (3+ extreme values)"
    ))
  } else {
    cat("⚠ Too many extreme cases to remove (", n_extreme, ",", 
        round(100 * n_extreme / nrow(baseline_data), 1), "%)\n")
    cat("  This suggests wide but plausible data range rather than true outliers\n")
    cat("  Skipping outlier removal test\n\n")
    all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
      Analysis = "Without Extreme Cases",
      AUC = NA,
      Difference = NA,
      Assessment = "Data range appropriate",
      Details = paste0(n_extreme, " cases with 3+ outliers (", 
                      round(100 * n_extreme / nrow(baseline_data), 1), "%)")
    ))
  }
} else {
  cat("No continuous variables to check\n\n")
}

#==============================================================================
# 5. AGE STRATIFICATION
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("TEST 5: AGE STRATIFICATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if("age" %in% names(baseline_data)) {
  
  # Create age groups
  data_with_age_group <- baseline_data %>%
    mutate(age_group = ifelse(age < 75, "65-74", "75+"))
  
  cat("Sample sizes by age group:\n")
  print(table(data_with_age_group$age_group))
  cat("\n")
  
  # Younger group
  data_young <- data_with_age_group %>% filter(age_group == "65-74")
  young_result <- fit_rf(data_young, all_predictors, outcome_var)
  
  # Older group
  data_old <- data_with_age_group %>% filter(age_group == "75+")
  old_result <- fit_rf(data_old, all_predictors, outcome_var)
  
  cat("RESULTS:\n")
  cat("  Full sample AUC:", round(baseline_auc, 3), "\n")
  cat("  Age 65-74 AUC:", round(young_result$auc, 3), "(n=", young_result$n, ")\n")
  cat("  Age 75+ AUC:", round(old_result$auc, 3), "(n=", old_result$n, ")\n")
  cat("  Difference:", round(abs(young_result$auc - old_result$auc), 3), "\n\n")
  
  all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
    Analysis = "Age 65-74",
    AUC = young_result$auc,
    Difference = young_result$auc - baseline_auc,
    Assessment = ifelse(abs(young_result$auc - old_result$auc) < 0.10, "Consistent", "Age-dependent"),
    Details = paste0("n=", young_result$n)
  ))
  
  all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
    Analysis = "Age 75+",
    AUC = old_result$auc,
    Difference = old_result$auc - baseline_auc,
    Assessment = ifelse(abs(young_result$auc - old_result$auc) < 0.10, "Consistent", "Age-dependent"),
    Details = paste0("n=", old_result$n)
  ))
  
  sensitivity_results$age_stratification <- list(
    young = young_result,
    old = old_result
  )
  
  if(abs(young_result$auc - old_result$auc) < 0.10) {
    cat("✓ CONSISTENT: Model performs similarly across age groups\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("⚠ AGE-DEPENDENT: Performance differs by age\n\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("Age variable not available\n\n")
}

# 6. SEX STRATIFICATION
```
