```{r}
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("TEST 6: SEX STRATIFICATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if("sex" %in% names(baseline_data)) {
  
  # Check sex coding
  sex_table <- table(baseline_data$sex)
  cat("Sample sizes by sex:\n")
  print(sex_table)
  cat("\n")
  
  # Get unique sex values
  sex_values <- sort(unique(baseline_data$sex[!is.na(baseline_data$sex)]))
  
  if(length(sex_values) >= 2) {
    
    # First group (should be female based on your coding)
    data_sex1 <- baseline_data %>% filter(sex == sex_values[1])
    sex1_result <- fit_rf(data_sex1, all_predictors, outcome_var)
    
    # Second group (should be male)
    data_sex2 <- baseline_data %>% filter(sex == sex_values[2])
    sex2_result <- fit_rf(data_sex2, all_predictors, outcome_var)
    
    # Determine labels
    sex1_label <- ifelse(is.factor(baseline_data$sex), 
                         levels(baseline_data$sex)[sex_values[1]], 
                         paste0("Sex ", sex_values[1]))
    sex2_label <- ifelse(is.factor(baseline_data$sex), 
                         levels(baseline_data$sex)[sex_values[2]], 
                         paste0("Sex ", sex_values[2]))
    
    cat("RESULTS:\n")
    cat("  Full sample AUC:", round(baseline_auc, 3), "\n")
    cat(" ", sex1_label, "AUC:", round(sex1_result$auc, 3), "(n=", sex1_result$n, ")\n")
    cat(" ", sex2_label, "AUC:", round(sex2_result$auc, 3), "(n=", sex2_result$n, ")\n")
    cat("  Difference:", round(abs(sex1_result$auc - sex2_result$auc), 3), "\n\n")
    
    all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
      Analysis = sex1_label,
      AUC = sex1_result$auc,
      Difference = sex1_result$auc - baseline_auc,
      Assessment = ifelse(abs(sex1_result$auc - sex2_result$auc) < 0.10, "Consistent", "Sex-dependent"),
      Details = paste0("n=", sex1_result$n)
    ))
    
    all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
      Analysis = sex2_label,
      AUC = sex2_result$auc,
      Difference = sex2_result$auc - baseline_auc,
      Assessment = ifelse(abs(sex1_result$auc - sex2_result$auc) < 0.10, "Consistent", "Sex-dependent"),
      Details = paste0("n=", sex2_result$n)
    ))
    
    sensitivity_results$sex_stratification <- list(
      sex1 = sex1_result,
      sex2 = sex2_result
    )
    
    if(abs(sex1_result$auc - sex2_result$auc) < 0.10) {
      cat("✓ CONSISTENT: Model performs similarly across sexes\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("⚠ SEX-DEPENDENT: Performance differs by sex\n\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("Only one sex category in data\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Sex variable not available\n\n")
}

#==============================================================================
# 7. INTERACTION TERMS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("TEST 7: INTERACTION TERMS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Testing key interactions: Age×Personality, Sex×Personality\n\n")

# Create interaction terms for key personality variables
key_personality <- big_five[1:min(3, length(big_five))]  # Use top 3 Big Five

interaction_data <- baseline_data

# Age interactions
if("age" %in% names(baseline_data) && length(key_personality) > 0) {
  for(trait in key_personality) {
    if(trait %in% names(baseline_data) && is.numeric(baseline_data[[trait]])) {
      int_name <- paste0("age_x_", trait)
      interaction_data[[int_name]] <- baseline_data$age * baseline_data[[trait]]
    }
  }
}

# Sex interactions
if("sex" %in% names(baseline_data) && length(key_personality) > 0) {
  for(trait in key_personality) {
    if(trait %in% names(baseline_data) && is.numeric(baseline_data[[trait]])) {
      int_name <- paste0("sex_x_", trait)
      sex_numeric <- as.numeric(as.factor(baseline_data$sex))
      interaction_data[[int_name]] <- sex_numeric * baseline_data[[trait]]
    }
  }
}

# Get interaction term names
interaction_terms <- grep("_x_", names(interaction_data), value = TRUE)

if(length(interaction_terms) > 0) {
  
  cat("Created", length(interaction_terms), "interaction terms\n\n")
  
  predictors_with_int <- c(all_predictors, interaction_terms)
  int_result <- fit_rf(interaction_data, predictors_with_int, outcome_var)
  
  cat("RESULTS:\n")
  cat("  Without interactions AUC:", round(baseline_auc, 3), "\n")
  cat("  With interactions AUC:", round(int_result$auc, 3), "\n")
  cat("  Difference:", round(int_result$auc - baseline_auc, 3), "\n\n")
  
  assessment <- ifelse(int_result$auc > baseline_auc + 0.03, "Interactions improve model",
                      ifelse(abs(int_result$auc - baseline_auc) < 0.03, "No meaningful interactions",
                             "Interactions worsen model"))
  
  all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
    Analysis = "With Interactions",
    AUC = int_result$auc,
    Difference = int_result$auc - baseline_auc,
    Assessment = assessment,
    Details = paste0(length(interaction_terms), " interactions")
  ))
  
  sensitivity_results$interactions <- int_result
  
  if(int_result$auc > baseline_auc + 0.03) {
    cat("✓ INTERACTIONS MATTER: Including interactions improves prediction\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ ADDITIVE EFFECTS: Main effects model is sufficient\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Could not create interaction terms\n\n")
}

#==============================================================================
# 8. SUBSCALE GROUPINGS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("TEST 8: PERSONALITY ASSESSMENT GROUPINGS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Comparing predictive value of different personality assessment groups\n\n")

# Big Five only
predictors_bf <- c(big_five, confounders)
bf_result <- fit_rf(baseline_data, predictors_bf, outcome_var)

# DBAS + SURPS + CISS only (excluding Big Five)
subscale_groups <- c(
  grep("^DBAS_", personality_subscales, value = TRUE),
  grep("^SURPS_", personality_subscales, value = TRUE),
  grep("^CISS_", personality_subscales, value = TRUE)
)
predictors_subscales <- c(subscale_groups, confounders)
subscales_result <- fit_rf(baseline_data, predictors_subscales, outcome_var)

cat("RESULTS:\n")
cat("  All 16 subscales AUC:", round(baseline_auc, 3), "\n")
cat("  Big Five only AUC:", round(bf_result$auc, 3), "(n=", bf_result$n, ")\n")
cat("  DBAS+SURPS+CISS only AUC:", round(subscales_result$auc, 3), "(n=", subscales_result$n, ")\n\n")

all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
  Analysis = "Big Five Only",
  AUC = bf_result$auc,
  Difference = bf_result$auc - baseline_auc,
  Assessment = ifelse(abs(bf_result$auc - baseline_auc) < 0.05, "Sufficient", "Subscales add value"),
  Details = paste0("n=", bf_result$n)
))

all_auc_results <- bind_rows(all_auc_results, data.frame(
  Analysis = "DBAS+SURPS+CISS Only",
  AUC = subscales_result$auc,
  Difference = subscales_result$auc - baseline_auc,
  Assessment = ifelse(abs(subscales_result$auc - baseline_auc) < 0.05, "Sufficient", "Big Five adds value"),
  Details = paste0("n=", subscales_result$n)
))

sensitivity_results$subscale_groups <- list(
  big_five_only = bf_result,
  subscales_only = subscales_result
)

if(baseline_auc > max(bf_result$auc, subscales_result$auc) + 0.03) {
  cat("✓ COMPLEMENTARY VALUE: Both assessment types improve prediction\n\n")
} else if(bf_result$auc > subscales_result$auc + 0.05) {
  cat("✓ BIG FIVE DOMINANT: Big Five traits are primary predictors\n\n")
} else if(subscales_result$auc > bf_result$auc + 0.05) {
  cat("✓ SUBSCALES DOMINANT: DBAS+SURPS+CISS are primary predictors\n\n")
} else {
  cat("✓ EQUIVALENT: Both groups provide similar predictive value\n\n")
}

#==============================================================================
# SUMMARY OF ALL ANALYSES
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SUMMARY OF SENSITIVITY ANALYSES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Baseline Random Forest AUC:", round(baseline_auc, 3), "\n\n")

# Display results table
cat("All Sensitivity Tests:\n\n")
results_display <- all_auc_results %>%
  mutate(
    AUC = round(AUC, 3),
    Difference = round(Difference, 3)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(AUC))

print(results_display, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# ROBUSTNESS ASSESSMENT
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("OVERALL ROBUSTNESS ASSESSMENT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Count tests by category
valid_tests <- all_auc_results %>% filter(!is.na(AUC))
n_total_tests <- nrow(valid_tests)

robust_tests <- valid_tests %>% 
  filter(abs(Difference) < 0.05 | grepl("Robust|Consistent|Sufficient", Assessment, ignore.case = TRUE))
n_robust <- nrow(robust_tests)

concerning_tests <- valid_tests %>%
  filter(abs(Difference) >= 0.05 & grepl("Concerning|dependent|sensitive", Assessment, ignore.case = TRUE))
n_concerning <- nrow(concerning_tests)

cat("Tests completed:", n_total_tests, "\n")
cat("Robust results:", n_robust, "(", round(100 * n_robust / n_total_tests, 1), "%)\n")
cat("Concerning results:", n_concerning, "(", round(100 * n_concerning / n_total_tests, 1), "%)\n\n")

# AUC range across all tests
auc_range <- max(valid_tests$AUC, na.rm = TRUE) - min(valid_tests$AUC, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("AUC range across tests:", round(auc_range, 3), "\n\n")

# Overall assessment
if(n_robust / n_total_tests >= 0.75 && auc_range < 0.10) {
  cat("╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
  cat("║  ✓ FINDINGS ARE ROBUST                                     ║\n")
  cat("║    Results are consistent across multiple conditions       ║\n")
  cat("╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")
} else if(n_robust / n_total_tests >= 0.50) {
  cat("╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
  cat("║  ⚠ FINDINGS ARE MODERATELY ROBUST                         ║\n")
  cat("║    Some sensitivity to specific conditions                 ║\n")
  cat("╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")
} else {
  cat("╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
  cat("║  ✗ FINDINGS SHOW SUBSTANTIAL SENSITIVITY                  ║\n")
  cat("║    Results vary considerably across conditions             ║\n")
  cat("╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n")
}

# Highlight concerning findings
if(n_concerning > 0) {
  cat("AREAS REQUIRING ATTENTION:\n")
  concerning_details <- valid_tests %>%
    filter(abs(Difference) >= 0.05 | grepl("Concerning|dependent", Assessment, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    select(Analysis, AUC, Difference, Assessment)
  print(concerning_details, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
}

# Key recommendations
cat("KEY RECOMMENDATIONS:\n\n")

if("Complete-Case" %in% valid_tests$Analysis) {
  cc_test <- valid_tests %>% filter(Analysis == "Complete-Case")
  if(abs(cc_test$Difference) >= 0.05) {
    cat("  • Missing data handling is critical - multiple imputation preferred\n")
  }
}

if(any(grepl("Without", valid_tests$Analysis))) {
  critical_traits <- valid_tests %>% 
    filter(grepl("Without", Analysis), abs(Difference) >= 0.05)
  if(nrow(critical_traits) > 0) {
    cat("  • Key personality traits identified:", 
        paste(gsub("Without ", "", critical_traits$Analysis), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}

if(any(grepl("Age|Sex", valid_tests$Analysis))) {
  stratified <- valid_tests %>% filter(grepl("Age|Sex", Analysis))
  if(max(stratified$AUC, na.rm = TRUE) - min(stratified$AUC, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0.10) {
    cat("  • Consider subgroup-specific models or interaction terms\n")
  }
}

if("With Interactions" %in% valid_tests$Analysis) {
  int_test <- valid_tests %>% filter(Analysis == "With Interactions")
  if(int_test$Difference > 0.03) {
    cat("  • Interaction effects improve predictions - consider including\n")
  }
}

cat("\n")

#==============================================================================

# Save comprehensive results

  baseline_auc = baseline_auc,

  detailed_results = sensitivity_results,
  summary = list(
    n_tests = n_total_tests,

    auc_range = auc_range
  )
)

saveRDS(sensitivity_output, "sensitivity_analysis_results.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: sensitivity_analysis_results.rds\n")

# Save summary table as CSV
write.csv(all_auc_results, "sensitivity_analysis_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: sensitivity_analysis_summary.csv\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Total runtime:", round(as.numeric(Sys.time() - start_time, units = "mins"), 1), "minutes\n\n")
```

## Follow-up

```{r}
################################################################################
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS FOLLOW-UP: COMPREHENSIVE SCRIPT (CORRECTED VERSION)
# Purpose: Test interactions, age stratification, missing data patterns, 
#          and model comparisons based on sensitivity analysis results
# 
# KEY CORRECTIONS:
# - Uses YOUR VSURF-selected personality variables (not just Big Five)
# - Works with YOUR imputed data (mice/mids object)
# - Tests ALL personality measures (BFI, DBAS, SURPS, CISS subscales)
# - Properly handles pooled results across imputations
################################################################################

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(pROC)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

set.seed(123)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS FOLLOW-UP\n")
cat("Based on findings from your comprehensive sensitivity analysis\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

################################################################################
# LOAD DATA AND VSURF RESULTS
################################################################################

cat("Loading data and VSURF-selected variables...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Load VSURF results
vsurf_personality <- readRDS("VSURF_results.rds")
vsurf_clinical <- readRDS("VSURF_clinical_results.rds")

# Load imputed data
mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")

# Define outcome
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

# Extract variable sets
demographics <- c("age", "sex", "income", "driving_freq")
personality_vars <- vsurf_personality$personality_selected
clinical_vars <- vsurf_clinical$clinical_selected

cat("Variables in analysis:\n")
cat("  Demographics:", length(demographics), "\n")
cat("  Personality:", length(personality_vars), "\n")
cat("  Clinical:", length(clinical_vars), "\n\n")

cat("Personality variables:\n")
for(i in seq_along(personality_vars)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %2d. %s\n", i, personality_vars[i]))
}
cat("\n")

################################################################################
# STEP 1: TEST SPECIFIC INTERACTIONS
################################################################################

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 1: TESTING INTERACTIONS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Function to test interaction across imputations
test_interaction <- function(mids_obj, outcome, demo_var, pers_var, 
                             other_preds, interaction_name) {
  
  # Build formula
  formula_str <- paste0(
    outcome, " ~ ",
    paste(other_preds, collapse = " + "),
    " + ", demo_var, " * ", pers_var
  )
  
  # Fit across imputations
  auc_list <- numeric(mids_obj$m)
  p_list <- numeric(mids_obj$m)
  
  for(i in 1:mids_obj$m) {
    data_i <- complete(mids_obj, i)
    model_i <- glm(as.formula(formula_str), data = data_i, family = binomial)
    
    # Get interaction p-value
    coef_names <- names(coef(model_i))
    interaction_term <- grep(":", coef_names, value = TRUE)
    if(length(interaction_term) > 0) {
      p_list[i] <- summary(model_i)$coefficients[interaction_term[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
    } else {
      p_list[i] <- NA
    }
    
    # Get AUC
    pred_i <- predict(model_i, type = "response")
    roc_i <- roc(data_i[[outcome]], pred_i, quiet = TRUE)
    auc_list[i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_i))
  }
  
  # Pool p-values using Rubin's rules (median)
  p_pooled <- median(p_list, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    Interaction = interaction_name,
    P_Value = p_pooled,
    AUC_mean = mean(auc_list),
    Significant = ifelse(!is.na(p_pooled) && p_pooled < 0.05, "YES", "NO")
  )
}

cat("Testing Age × Personality interactions...\n")

age_int_results <- lapply(personality_vars, function(pvar) {
  other <- c(setdiff(demographics, "age"), 
             setdiff(personality_vars, pvar), 
             clinical_vars)
  
  test_interaction(mids_data, outcome_var, "age", pvar, other,
                   paste0("Age × ", pvar))
}) %>% bind_rows()

cat("\nTesting Sex × Personality interactions...\n")

sex_int_results <- lapply(personality_vars, function(pvar) {
  other <- c(setdiff(demographics, "sex"), 
             setdiff(personality_vars, pvar), 
             clinical_vars)
  
  test_interaction(mids_data, outcome_var, "sex", pvar, other,
                   paste0("Sex × ", pvar))
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Combine and rank
all_interactions <- bind_rows(age_int_results, sex_int_results) %>%
  arrange(P_Value)

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("INTERACTION TEST RESULTS (Top 10)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

print(head(all_interactions, 10), row.names = FALSE, digits = 4)

sig_interactions <- all_interactions %>% filter(P_Value < 0.05)

if(nrow(sig_interactions) > 0) {
  cat("\n*** SIGNIFICANT INTERACTIONS (p < .05): ***\n\n")
  print(sig_interactions, row.names = FALSE, digits = 4)
  cat("\n⚠ Consider including these in your final model!\n")
} else {
  cat("\n✓ No significant interactions at p < .05\n")
}

################################################################################
# STEP 2: AGE-STRATIFIED ANALYSIS
################################################################################

cat("\n\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 2: AGE-STRATIFIED MODELS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Build formula for stratified models (exclude age)
all_preds <- c(demographics, personality_vars, clinical_vars)
preds_no_age <- setdiff(all_preds, "age")
formula_strat <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", 
                                  paste(preds_no_age, collapse = " + ")))

# Analyze by age group
age_results_younger <- list()
age_results_older <- list()

for(i in 1:mids_data$m) {
  data_i <- complete(mids_data, i)
  data_i$age_group <- ifelse(data_i$age < 75, "younger", "older")
  
  # Younger group
  data_younger <- data_i %>% filter(age_group == "younger")
  model_younger <- glm(formula_strat, data = data_younger, family = binomial)
  pred_younger <- predict(model_younger, type = "response")
  roc_younger <- roc(data_younger[[outcome_var]], pred_younger, quiet = TRUE)
  
  age_results_younger[[i]] <- list(
    n = nrow(data_younger),
    auc = as.numeric(auc(roc_younger)),
    coef = coef(model_younger)
  )
  
  # Older group  
  data_older <- data_i %>% filter(age_group == "older")
  model_older <- glm(formula_strat, data = data_older, family = binomial)
  pred_older <- predict(model_older, type = "response")
  roc_older <- roc(data_older[[outcome_var]], pred_older, quiet = TRUE)
  
  age_results_older[[i]] <- list(
    n = nrow(data_older),
    auc = as.numeric(auc(roc_older)),
    coef = coef(model_older)
  )
}

# Summarize
n_younger <- age_results_younger[[1]]$n
n_older <- age_results_older[[1]]$n

auc_younger <- mean(sapply(age_results_younger, function(x) x$auc))
auc_older <- mean(sapply(age_results_older, function(x) x$auc))

cat(sprintf("Younger-old (65-74): n=%d, AUC=%.3f\n", n_younger, auc_younger))
cat(sprintf("Older-old (75+):     n=%d, AUC=%.3f\n", n_older, auc_older))
cat(sprintf("Difference: %.3f\n\n", abs(auc_younger - auc_older)))

if(auc_younger > 0.75 || auc_older > 0.75) {
  cat("⚠ Age-stratified models show HIGHER performance than combined!\n")
  cat("  This suggests age-specific effects are important.\n")
}

# Compare coefficients
coef_names <- names(age_results_younger[[1]]$coef)
coef_younger_avg <- sapply(coef_names, function(cn) {
  mean(sapply(age_results_younger, function(x) x$coef[cn]), na.rm = TRUE)
})
coef_older_avg <- sapply(coef_names, function(cn) {
  mean(sapply(age_results_older, function(x) x$coef[cn]), na.rm = TRUE)
})

coef_comp <- data.frame(
  Predictor = coef_names,
  Younger_OR = exp(coef_younger_avg),
  Older_OR = exp(coef_older_avg),
  OR_Ratio = exp(coef_younger_avg) / exp(coef_older_avg)
) %>%
  filter(Predictor != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    Large_Diff = abs(log(OR_Ratio)) > log(1.5)
  )

age_specific <- coef_comp %>% filter(Large_Diff)

if(nrow(age_specific) > 0) {
  cat("\n*** PREDICTORS WITH AGE-SPECIFIC EFFECTS: ***\n\n")
  print(age_specific %>% select(Predictor, Younger_OR, Older_OR), 
        row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
}

################################################################################
# STEP 3: MISSING DATA CHARACTERIZATION
################################################################################

cat("\n\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 3: MISSING DATA ANALYSIS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

original_data <- mids_data$data
original_data$has_missing <- apply(original_data, 1, function(x) any(is.na(x)))

n_complete <- sum(!original_data$has_missing)
n_incomplete <- sum(original_data$has_missing)

cat(sprintf("Complete cases: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            n_complete, 100 * n_complete / nrow(original_data)))
cat(sprintf("Incomplete cases: %d (%.1f%%)\n\n", 
            n_incomplete, 100 * n_incomplete / nrow(original_data)))

# Variables with most missing data
missing_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(original_data),
  N_Missing = colSums(is.na(original_data)),
  Pct_Missing = 100 * colSums(is.na(original_data)) / nrow(original_data)
) %>%
  filter(N_Missing > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(N_Missing)) %>%
  head(10)

if(nrow(missing_summary) > 0) {
  cat("Top 10 variables with missing data:\n\n")
  print(missing_summary, row.names = FALSE, digits = 2)
  cat("\n")
}

# Test if outcome differs by missingness
if(outcome_var %in% names(original_data)) {
  outcome_by_missing <- table(original_data$has_missing, 
                               original_data[[outcome_var]])
  
  if(ncol(outcome_by_missing) == 2) {
    props <- prop.table(outcome_by_missing, 1)
    chi_result <- chisq.test(outcome_by_missing)
    
    cat("Discontinuation rate:\n")
    cat(sprintf("  Complete cases: %.1f%%\n", props[1,2] * 100))
    cat(sprintf("  Incomplete cases: %.1f%%\n", props[2,2] * 100))
    cat(sprintf("  p = %.4f", chi_result$p.value))
    
    if(chi_result$p.value < 0.05) {
      cat(" **\n\n⚠ Missing data is NOT random (MNAR)\n")
      cat("  Multiple imputation was the correct choice!\n")
    } else {
      cat("\n\n✓ Outcome similar regardless of missing data\n")
    }
  }
}

################################################################################
# STEP 4: MODEL COMPARISON (Logistic vs your original model)
################################################################################

cat("\n\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 4: LOGISTIC REGRESSION MODEL\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Build full logistic model
formula_full <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", 
                                 paste(all_preds, collapse = " + ")))

cat("Fitting logistic regression across", mids_data$m, "imputations...\n")

logistic_results <- lapply(1:mids_data$m, function(i) {
  data_i <- complete(mids_data, i)
  model_i <- glm(formula_full, data = data_i, family = binomial)
  
  pred_i <- predict(model_i, type = "response")
  roc_i <- roc(data_i[[outcome_var]], pred_i, quiet = TRUE)
  
  list(
    model = model_i,
    auc = as.numeric(auc(roc_i))
  )
})

auc_logistic <- mean(sapply(logistic_results, function(x) x$auc))
auc_logistic_sd <- sd(sapply(logistic_results, function(x) x$auc))

cat(sprintf("\nLogistic Regression AUC: %.3f (SD = %.3f)\n", 
            auc_logistic, auc_logistic_sd))
cat(sprintf("95%% CI: [%.3f, %.3f]\n", 
            auc_logistic - 1.96*auc_logistic_sd,
            auc_logistic + 1.96*auc_logistic_sd))

# Pool coefficients
fit_list <- lapply(logistic_results, function(x) x$model)
fit_mira <- as.mira(fit_list)
pooled_logistic <- pool(fit_mira)
summary_logistic <- summary(pooled_logistic, conf.int = TRUE)

# Convert to OR
summary_logistic <- summary_logistic %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(estimate),
    OR_lower = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
    OR_upper = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error)
  ) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")

cat("\n\nTop 10 strongest predictors (by |coefficient|):\n\n")
top_predictors <- summary_logistic %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  select(term, OR, OR_lower, OR_upper, p.value)

print(top_predictors, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)

################################################################################
# STEP 5: SIMPLIFIED MODEL (Personality only vs Full model)
################################################################################

cat("\n\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STEP 5: MODEL SIMPLIFICATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Simplified model: Demographics + Personality only
formula_simple <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", 
                                   paste(c(demographics, personality_vars), 
                                         collapse = " + ")))

cat("Comparing models:\n")
cat("  Simple: Demographics + Personality (", 
    length(demographics) + length(personality_vars), " predictors)\n", sep = "")
cat("  Full:   Demographics + Personality + Clinical (", 
    length(all_preds), " predictors)\n\n", sep = "")

simple_results <- lapply(1:mids_data$m, function(i) {
  data_i <- complete(mids_data, i)
  model_i <- glm(formula_simple, data = data_i, family = binomial)
  
  pred_i <- predict(model_i, type = "response")
  roc_i <- roc(data_i[[outcome_var]], pred_i, quiet = TRUE)
  
  as.numeric(auc(roc_i))
})

auc_simple <- mean(unlist(simple_results))

cat(sprintf("Simple model AUC: %.3f\n", auc_simple))
cat(sprintf("Full model AUC:   %.3f\n", auc_logistic))
cat(sprintf("Difference:       %.3f\n\n", auc_logistic - auc_simple))

if(abs(auc_logistic - auc_simple) < 0.02) {
  cat("✓ Simplified model performs nearly as well as full model!\n")
  cat("  Clinical variables add minimal predictive value.\n")
  cat("  Consider using simplified model for clinical practice.\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠ Full model shows meaningful improvement.\n")
  cat("  Clinical variables add important information.\n")
}

################################################################################
# VISUALIZATIONS
################################################################################

cat("\n\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CREATING VISUALIZATIONS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# 1. Model comparison plot
model_comp_data <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Simple (Demo+Pers)", "Full (Demo+Pers+Clin)", 
            "Age 65-74", "Age 75+"),
  AUC = c(auc_simple, auc_logistic, auc_younger, auc_older),
  N_Predictors = c(length(demographics) + length(personality_vars),
                   length(all_preds),
                   length(preds_no_age),
                   length(preds_no_age))
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: Omnibus tests by domain (before FDR)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Testing which variables show ANY difference between clusters...\n\n")

# Function to test one variable
test_one_variable <- function(var, data, cluster_var = "cluster") {
  
  # Skip if all NA
  if(all(is.na(data[[var]]))) {
    return(list(var = var, test = "NA", statistic = NA, p = NA, effect_size = NA))
  }
  
  # Determine test type
  if(is.numeric(data[[var]])) {
    # Continuous: Kruskal-Wallis (non-parametric ANOVA)
    test_result <- kruskal.test(as.formula(paste(var, "~", cluster_var)), data = data)
    
    # Effect size: Epsilon squared
    epsilon_sq <- tryCatch({
      effectsize::rank_epsilon_squared(as.formula(paste(var, "~", cluster_var)), data = data)$Epsilon2
    }, error = function(e) NA)
    
    return(list(
      var = var,
      test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
      statistic = test_result$statistic,
      p = test_result$p.value,
      effect_size = epsilon_sq
    ))
    
  } else {
    # Categorical: Chi-square
    tab <- table(data[[cluster_var]], data[[var]])
    
    # Check if test is valid
    expected <- chisq.test(tab)$expected
    if(any(expected < 5)) {
      return(list(var = var, test = "Chi-square (low counts)", statistic = NA, p = NA, effect_size = NA))
    }
    
    test_result <- chisq.test(tab)
    
    # Effect size: Cramér's V
    cramers_v <- tryCatch({
      effectsize::cramers_v(tab)$Cramers_v
    }, error = function(e) NA)
    
    return(list(
      var = var,
      test = "Chi-square",
      statistic = test_result$statistic,
      p = test_result$p.value,
      effect_size = cramers_v
    ))
  }
}

# Test all variables by domain

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: FDR correction (Benjamini-Hochberg) by domain\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("FDR THRESHOLD: q = 0.05\n")
cat("METHOD: Benjamini-Hochberg procedure\n\n")

# Function to apply FDR and summarize
apply_fdr_correction <- function(results_df, domain_name, q = 0.05) {
  
  if(nrow(results_df) == 0 || all(is.na(results_df$p))) {
    cat("  ", domain_name, ": No valid tests\n\n")
    return(results_df %>% mutate(q_value = NA, significant = FALSE))
  }
  
  # Remove NA p-values
  results_clean <- results_df %>% filter(!is.na(p))
  
  if(nrow(results_clean) == 0) {
    cat("  ", domain_name, ": No valid tests\n\n")
    return(results_df %>% mutate(q_value = NA, significant = FALSE))
  }
  
  # Apply FDR correction
  results_clean$q_value <- p.adjust(results_clean$p, method = "BH")
  results_clean$significant <- results_clean$q_value < q
  
  # Count significant
  n_sig <- sum(results_clean$significant, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_total <- nrow(results_clean)
  
  cat("  ", domain_name, ":\n")
  cat("    Tests conducted:", n_total, "\n")
  cat("    Significant (q < 0.05):", n_sig, 
      "(", round(100 * n_sig / n_total, 1), "%)\n")
  
  if(n_sig > 0) {
    cat("    Significant variables:\n")
    sig_vars <- results_clean %>% filter(significant) %>% pull(var)
    for(v in sig_vars) {
      cat("      •", v, "\n")
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # Add back NA rows
  results_final <- results_df %>%
    left_join(results_clean %>% select(var, q_value, significant), by = "var") %>%
    mutate(
      q_value = ifelse(is.na(p), NA, q_value),
      significant = ifelse(is.na(p), FALSE, replace_na(significant, FALSE))
    )
  
  return(results_final)
}

cat("APPLYING FDR CORRECTION:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

clinical_fdr <- apply_fdr_correction(clinical_results, "Clinical/Health")
demographic_fdr <- apply_fdr_correction(demographic_results, "Demographics")

cat("PART D: Creating detailed comparison tables\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Function to create detailed table with means/proportions by cluster
create_detailed_table <- function(sig_vars, data, cluster_var = "cluster") {
  
  if(length(sig_vars) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  detailed_list <- list()
  
  for(var in sig_vars) {
    if(is.numeric(data[[var]])) {
      # Continuous: means and SDs by cluster
      summary_stats <- data %>%
        group_by(!!sym(cluster_var)) %>%
        summarise(
          mean = mean(!!sym(var), na.rm = TRUE),
          sd = sd(!!sym(var), na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(summary = paste0(round(mean, 2), " (", round(sd, 2), ")")) %>%
        select(!!sym(cluster_var), summary) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = cluster_var, values_from = summary)
      
      detailed_list[[var]] <- summary_stats %>%
        mutate(Variable = var, .before = 1)
      
    } else {
      # Categorical: proportions by cluster
      prop_table <- data %>%
        group_by(!!sym(cluster_var), !!sym(var)) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
        group_by(!!sym(cluster_var)) %>%
        mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
        mutate(summary = paste0(n, " (", pct, "%)")) %>%
        select(!!sym(cluster_var), !!sym(var), summary) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = cluster_var, values_from = summary)
      
      detailed_list[[var]] <- prop_table %>%
        mutate(Variable = var, .before = 1)
    }
  }
  
  return(bind_rows(detailed_list))
}

cat("Based on FDR-corrected differences, here's how to describe each cluster:\n\n")

for(i in 1:k) {
  cat("CLUSTER", i, ":", cluster_names[i], "\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  # Get defining features (variables where this cluster is high or low)
  defining_features <- list()
  
  for(var in all_sig_vars) {
    if(is.numeric(cluster_data[[var]])) {
      cluster_means <- cluster_data %>%
        group_by(cluster) %>%
        summarise(m = mean(!!sym(var), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
      
      this_mean <- cluster_means$m[i]
      overall_mean <- mean(cluster_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      
      if(this_mean > overall_mean + 0.5 * sd(cluster_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)) {
        defining_features[[var]] <- "HIGH"
      } else if(this_mean < overall_mean - 0.5 * sd(cluster_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)) {
        defining_features[[var]] <- "LOW"
      }
    }
  }
  
  if(length(defining_features) > 0) {
    cat("Defining features:\n")
    for(feat in names(defining_features)) {
      cat("  •", defining_features[[feat]], feat, "\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No strong defining features (close to average on most variables)\n")
  }
  
  # Discontinuation rate
  discont_rate <- clustering_results$discontinuation_by_cluster %>%
    filter(cluster == paste0("Cluster_", i)) %>%
    pull(Discontinuation_Rate)
  
  cat("Discontinuation rate:", discont_rate, "%\n")
  cat("\n")
}
```
